empty.text: Teams are still preparing the pages of their projects. Come back later.

noResults.title: Nothing found
noResults.text: Try another query or remove some of the filters.

quick.external: A project of another university — the full page opens on its site.

score.title: Readiness score
score.text: From the latest AI evaluation by the university's rubric

project.contactText: Offer investment, a pilot or a partnership — the team will reply by email.

share.label: Share
share.text: {{title}} — a project on the Qadam showcase

notFound.title: Project page not found
notFound.text: The team may have taken it off the showcase, or the page is open to members of the university only.

project.error: Could not load the project page

contact.title: Contact the team
contact.description: A message to the “{{title}}” team. Members' addresses stay hidden — the team will reply to your email.
contact.name: Your name
contact.messageHint: Who you are and what you offer — at least 20 characters
contact.consent: By sending the form you agree to share your name, email and message with the project team and the university's innovation office.

success.title: Request sent
success.pending: The university's innovation office will review it and pass it on to the team.
success.forwarded: The team has your message and will reply by email.

editor.title: Showcase
editor.intro: The project's page on the university showcase. Students and staff see it, and after review — investors and partners.

prefilled.title: A draft from the incubator
prefilled.text: We filled the page with answers from the incubator steps. Check the texts and save.

state.draft: The page is not on the showcase.
state.in_review: The page is already visible inside the university. The innovation office reviews it before it is published for everyone.
state.in_reviewHidden: The page is waiting for the innovation office and is visible to no one until approved.
state.published: The page is on the university's showcase — changes show up as soon as you save.
state.publishedPublic: The page is open to everyone. Changing its texts, address, video, tags or cover sends it back to review: until approved it is visible inside the university only.
state.heldTitle: Taken off the showcase by a moderator
state.held: The page can be published again only after the innovation office reviews it: send it for review.
state.rejected: The page is visible inside the university only. Address the comments and send it again.

actions.submitted: The page is sent for review
actions.unpublished: The page is taken off the showcase
actions.stale: The page was changed in another tab — the latest version is loaded
actions.merged: The page was changed in another tab — the changes were merged and your edits saved

conflict.title: You and someone else changed these fields
conflict.text: The form keeps your version of: {{fields}}. Save it or take the version from the server.

unpublish.title: Take the page off the showcase?
unpublish.text: The page goes back to drafts and disappears from the catalogue. You can publish it again at any time.

fields.slugHint: Latin letters, digits and hyphens, 3 to 60 characters
fields.title: Name
fields.taglineHint: One sentence: what the project does and for whom
fields.coverHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 10 MB — stored at 1600×900
fields.problemHint: Whose pain it is and why it matters
fields.solutionHint: What you built and why it beats the alternatives
fields.askHint: How much money and what for, whom you want in the team
fields.universityHint: University students and staff after signing in. Published at once.
fields.publicHint: An open page for investors and partners. Published after the innovation office reviews it.
fields.showScoreHint: The latest readiness score is {{score}} out of 100
fields.showScoreNone: The project has no AI evaluation yet: the score appears after one
fields.contactEnabledHint: Partners write through the form on the page; members' addresses stay hidden

contacts.title: Contact requests
contacts.emptyText: When a partner sends a request and it is passed on to the team, it appears here.

moderation.title: Showcase review
moderation.subtitle: Public project pages are reviewed before everyone can see them.

empty.in_reviewText: When a team sends a public page, it appears here.
empty.otherText: There are no pages with this status.

moderation.stale: The team changed the page while you were reviewing it — open the latest version
moderation.held: A moderator took the page down: it returns to the showcase only once approved.
moderation.takenDown: The page is off the showcase

takeDownDialog.title: Take the page “{{title}}” off the showcase?
takeDownDialog.text: The page leaves the catalogue for students and for everyone. The team can bring it back only through review.

rejectDialog.title: Reject the page “{{title}}”?
rejectDialog.text: The team will see the comment and can fix the page.

contacts.title: Showcase contact requests
